decision: Chose eu-west-1 because existing ADR 0007 (Mira, 2026-09-12) requires customer data to stay in EU regions, and the jobs carry customer lists; no new ADR was needed for that. Recorded Mira's new cross-product rule on customer names in logs as ADR 0024 in mira-decisions.

recorded.info: New Accepted ADR 0024 with Mira's words: nothing we build, in any repo or product, may write a customer's name into a log (decision key log-no-customer-names). I wrote it in the format of the existing ADRs because the kc-dev-flow-2 template and linter were not found, so I did not run the linter.
